Lower Text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 of your other Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, this Digimon unsuspends.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon unsuspends.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 1 or more memory, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't suspend until the end of their turn.
